title: Projection-Bridge Non-Unification Gate
purpose: Reject any bridge artifact that escalates QM-like / GR-like projection comparison into unification, derivation, physical equivalence, or physical-law claims.

gate_definition.definition: Any bridge artifact comparing QM-like and GR-like projections must remain analog-only and must not claim derivation, physical equivalence, source identity, or theory unification.

required_checks.name: reject_unification_language
required_checks.rule: Reject artifacts using bridge comparison as proof of QM/GR unification.

required_checks.name: reject_derivation_language
required_checks.rule: Reject artifacts claiming quantum mechanics or general relativity has been derived.

required_checks.name: reject_physical_equivalence_language
required_checks.rule: Reject artifacts claiming QM-like or GR-like projections are physically equivalent to real theories.

required_checks.name: require_analog_only_claim_level
required_checks.rule: Every bridge artifact must set claim_level to BRIDGE_ANALOG_ONLY.

required_checks.name: require_conflict_preservation
required_checks.rule: Bridge conflicts must be recorded and may not be collapsed into unity language.

required_checks.name: block_source_identity_promotion
required_checks.rule: Shared source traceability cannot be promoted to source identity proof.

forbidden_terms_or_patterns: unifies quantum mechanics and general relativity
